translations.web: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
translations.bsb: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.
translations.kjv: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
translations.asv: For God sent not the Son into the world to judge the world; but that the world should be saved through him.
